name: Personal Drive
description: p.124. Roll 2D to generate a personal goal for a spacer, or use the table for examples.

results.text: Revenge: You are driven to find catharsis from your pain by doing whatever is necessary to achieve revenge.
Justice: You have been wronged and seek to even the score to make things right.
Escape: You seek to disappear among the stars, running away from pain and conflict.
Survive: Life constantly throws obstacles at you, and you just want to make it to see tomorrow and get by without hassle.
Freedom: You have always been repressed and stepped on, incapable of escaping your lot in life. Now opportunity has shown you a means to break free.
Purpose: You have felt aimless, and maybe still do. While your past experiences never fulfilled you, maybe your destiny lies in the stars beyond.
New Life: You want to reinvent yourself by taking on a life change. In space, you can become anyone you want.

Wealth: You work tirelessly to seek financial independence, to make life comfortable in your future so you can finally settle down and live a life free of danger. Or perhaps you instead seek wealth for influence, power, or to give charity.
Faith: You have had a spiritual awakening, discovering the possibility that there is something bigger than yourself out in space that will bring you peace.
Honour: Your reputation has been blemished in some way, and you seek to fix that.
Redemption: You haven’t always been a great individual. You have justified your past actions as a means to an end, but now you are driven to right the wrongs you have done
